title: Reverse predicate-lock direction: tighten max_pred_locks_per_page/relation
configuration_cause: Prior action raised max_pred_locks_per_page 2->16 and max_pred_locks_per_relation -2->64; paired result was early_stopped_worse (-14.4% TPS, GetUserTweets p99 +25%). The direction is falsified, so reverse it with equal-or-larger safe amplitude.
mechanism: The prior test increased predicate-lock granularity, which lengthened GetUserTweets p99 by 25% and cut TPS 14.4% with zero lock waits and zero retries. That refutes the 'more SIRead slots reduce promotion' direction. Reversing to a tighter-than-default granularity (page 0, relation 0) forces coarser SIRead locking, reducing per-tuple predicate-lock bookkeeping on the dominant read path. With lock_waiting_backends and conflicts at 0, the cost of coarser locks is bounded, while the benefit is less lock-table churn per GetUserTweets transaction.
query_effect: GetUserTweets (88.5% of terminal capacity) should see lower p99 as predicate-lock bookkeeping per scan shrinks; no plan change expected.
expected_tps_effect: Increase successful_transaction_tps versus the refuted treatment; target at least parity with the 21876 control and ideally above.
expected_latency_effect: Decrease GetUserTweets p99 relative to the 1644us treatment value; bounded by zero lock waits.

predictions.rationale: Reversing the falsified granularity increase should recover the 25% p99 regression seen in the treatment.
Recovering the -14.4% TPS loss from the refuted direction; coarser SIRead locks reduce per-txn lock churn.
Baseline lock waits are already 0; coarser locks must not introduce blocking waits.

alternatives.statement: If TPS is instead limited by WAL sync cadence, tightening predicate locks will be neutral and wal_buffers/wal_writer_delay changes would move TPS.
If low_buffer_hit_ratio drives GetUserTweets latency, shared_buffers/effective_cache_size changes would move blks_read and p99 rather than predicate-lock knobs.

why_exceeds_incumbent: The prior granularity increase was falsified (early_stopped_worse). Reversing to tighter-than-default predicate-lock granularity is the only untested direction in this knob family and directly targets the dominant GetUserTweets path with zero observed lock-wait risk.

nodes.label: Coarser SIRead locking reduces per-txn lock churn

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Reverse of falsified 2->16; 0 is the safe low bound, forcing coarser page-level SIRead locking.
Reverse of falsified -2->64; 0 is the safe low bound, coarsening relation-level SIRead locking.
